verdict.rationale: Bolna's docs say TTS providers can be connected from Settings → Integrations and name Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs "and more." They also say users can choose different voices, accents and speaking styles, which covers both halves of the story. missing for 10: a quantified or browsable voice-library catalog showing breadth, a full TTS provider list with per-provider voice-selection details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Bolna supports Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, and more.
You can choose different voices, accents, and speaking styles to match your brand.
Every provider you can bring to Bolna — telephony, LLM, TTS, STT and tools — is connected from a single place in the dashboard: Settings → Integrations.
When you bring your own keys (BYOK), Bolna does not charge for those components.
